name: @mgds/workspace
description: Model Game Development Standard reference workspace

scripts.campaign:evaluate: node scripts/evaluate-campaign.mjs --plan artifacts/campaigns/p2-plan.json --runs artifacts/campaigns/p2-runs.json --evidence artifacts/campaigns/p2-evidence.json --evaluators versions/evaluator-authorities.json --output artifacts/campaigns/p2-result.json
scripts.release:p2:check: node scripts/check-p2-release.mjs --candidate versions/v0.1.0-preview.1.json --config campaigns/p2/campaign.json --runs results/p2/runs.json --evidence results/p2/evidence.json --hosts results/p2/host-t0.json --review artifacts/release/p2/review.json --review-report artifacts/release/p2/review.html --signing artifacts/release/p2/signing.json --evaluators versions/evaluator-authorities.json --reviewers artifacts/release/p2/reviewer-authorities.json --release-authorities artifacts/release/p2/release-authorities.json --output artifacts/release/p2-gate.json
scripts.unity:test: uv run python scripts/run-unity-package-tests.py --package Packages/org.mgds.unity.core --output artifacts/unity/core.xml && uv run python scripts/run-unity-package-tests.py --package Packages/org.mgds.unity.editor --output artifacts/unity/editor.xml && uv run python scripts/run-unity-package-tests.py --package Packages/org.mgds.unity.player --output artifacts/unity/player.xml && uv run python scripts/run-unity-package-tests.py --package Packages/org.mgds.unity.semantic --output artifacts/unity/semantic.xml && uv run python scripts/run-unity-package-tests.py --package Packages/org.mgds.unity.multiplayer --output artifacts/unity/multiplayer.xml && uv run python scripts/run-golden-arena-tests.py
scripts.check: pnpm validate:smoke && pnpm schemas:check && pnpm generated:check && pnpm license:check && pnpm test
